remarks: Location, Location, Location! Welcome home to 7 Hamilton Avenue Unit 32, Norwalk CT-a charming, well-maintained condo offering convenience, comfort, and easy access to everything Norwalk has to offer. Ideally situated just off I-95 and only minutes from the South Norwalk train station, this home is truly perfect for commuters and travelers alike. Step inside to find beautiful hardwood flooring and an open-concept living and dining area, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The kitchen features bright, refreshed cabinetry and a stylish subway tile backsplash, creating a clean and modern feel. From the living room, sliding glass doors lead to your private balcony-a wonderful spot to enjoy morning coffee on warm days. Both bedrooms offer comfortable space with wall-to-wall carpeting. The in-unit washer and dryer add everyday convenience, tucked neatly behind accordion doors to keep the space tidy and functional. Enjoy all that Norwalk has to offer-from scenic views along Norwalk Harbor to a fun afternoon exploring the Maritime Aquarium. Shopping, dining, entertainment, and transportation are all just moments away. This condo is truly a commuter's dream-and an excellent opportunity for anyone looking for low-maintenance living in a prime location. Don't miss your chance-schedule your showing today! Pet Policy: Association allows up to two small pets.
